text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Legal Islamist party Hamas will refuse to change its title to conform to law banning parties from having political platform based on religion.
- Algerian companies will no longer benefit from state 'manna'. From Monday, firms must deal directly with banks for finance and face choice of economic performance or bankruptcy.
- Annual inflation falls under 10 percent threshold, with January 1996 to January 1997 figure 9.8 percent, ending era of double-digit price rises.

- National Liberation Front leadership tries to patch up splits in party ranks after group of 20 reformists publish statement criticising direction of party ahead of June 5 general election. Group accuses leaders of taking party into dead end and of being out of touch with rank and file.
